name: Moonpetal Overnight Balm
description: A rich overnight balm with squalane and shea butter that locks in moisture while you sleep, designed to soothe dry, tight-feeling skin and support the skin barrier overnight.

name: Hydra-Mist Toning Essence
description: A lightweight hydrating essence with hyaluronic acid and rose water that preps skin to better absorb serums and moisturizers, ideal as a first step for dry or dehydrated skin.

name: Calm Root Evening Tonic
description: A calming tonic blending ashwagandha, chamomile, and magnesium glycinate, formulated as an evening ritual drink to support relaxation and an easier wind-down before sleep.

name: Quiet Mind Magnesium Capsules
description: A gentle magnesium and L-theanine capsule formulated to support nervous system relaxation as part of a simple, low-effort evening routine.

name: Golden Hour Vitamin C Serum
description: A brightening vitamin C serum with ferulic acid designed for morning use to protect skin against environmental stressors and even out tone.

name: Barefoot Ritual Body Oil
description: A lightweight body oil with jojoba and lavender that softens dry skin while its calming scent supports an evening wind-down ritual.

name: Bright Start Electrolyte Blend
description: A morning electrolyte and B-vitamin blend designed to support hydration and energy at the start of the day.

name: Slow Bloom Gentle Cleansing Balm
description: A gentle cleansing balm with chamomile and sunflower oil that removes the day's makeup and residue without stripping or tightening dry skin.
